name: Rahul Sharma
bio: A prolific striker from Mumbai who led the state league in goals for two consecutive seasons and earned a call-up to the national U-23 camp.

name: Arjun Mehta
bio: A tireless midfielder from Pune known for orchestrating play from the center and recording the most assists in the regional tournament.

name: Priya Nair
bio: A commanding centre-back from Kerala who anchored her college team's backline and was named Defensive Player of the Year at the inter-university championship.

name: Vikram Patel
bio: An experienced shot-stopper from Gujarat with over 150 clean sheets across club and state-level competitions, renowned for his positioning and reflexes.

name: Sanya Kapoor
bio: A electrifying young winger from Delhi whose pace and trickery on the flanks earned her the Young Player of the Tournament award at the national U-19 championship.

name: Karan Singh
bio: A dynamic point guard from Chandigarh who averaged a double-double in the national league and led his team to back-to-back final four appearances.

name: Deepika Rao
bio: A sharp-shooting guard from Bengaluru who broke the state three-point record in her rookie season and was selected for the national development squad.

name: Manish Kumar
bio: A versatile forward from Patna with a strong mid-range game and five years of experience in the national league, known for his consistency on both ends.

name: Anaya Verma
bio: A dominant power forward from Indore who led the national league in rebounds and was voted Most Valuable Player at the inter-state championship.

name: Rohan Gupta
bio: A towering center from Jaipur with seven seasons of professional experience, anchoring the paint with elite rim protection and solid post moves.

name: Meera Iyer
bio: A blazing sprinter from Chennai who broke the national 100m record at age 19 and became the youngest Indian to qualify for the World Athletics Championships.

name: Aditya Joshi
bio: A gritty long-distance runner from Dehradun who won the national 10,000m title three years running and represented India at the Asian Games.

name: Lakshmi Reddy
bio: A technical hurdler from Hyderabad who claimed gold at the South Asian Games and holds the state record in the 100m hurdles.

name: Suresh Nair
bio: A high jumper from Kochi who cleared 2.25m at the national championship and earned a silver medal at the Asian Indoor Athletics meet.

name: Pooja Desai
bio: A versatile decathlete from Nagpur who competes across ten events and placed fourth at the national championship, showcasing remarkable all-round ability.
